name: Sails in the Fog
source:
To avoid an unwanted marriage, Adelaide joins a band of pirates and sets sail into a realm of danger and wonder. 

Along the way she meets allies and enemies – human and supernatural alike – as the creeping Fog pushes the world toward ruin.

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Sails_in_the_Fog]romance-club.fandom[/url]
translation:
为了避免一场不想要的婚姻，阿德莱德加入了海盗团伙，扬帆驶入充满危险和奇迹的国度。

一路上，她遇到了盟友和敌人——人类和超自然力量——随着蔓延的迷雾将世界推向毁灭。

来自 [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Sails_in_the_Fog]romance-club.fandom[/url]
